title: When the Trail Sings
author: Quentin Nystrom
blurb: Vesper Zhou, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
